description: Relationship guide for the split catalog files.

files.catalog-products.json: 230 parent listings; light summary and foreign keys.
files.product-variants.json: 1,115 SKU rows with selected options, price, stock, logistics and their own imageUrl.
files.product-descriptions.json: Long and short descriptions split from product summaries.
files.product-media.json: Unique image gallery for every parent product, mapped back to variant IDs.
files.product-category-map.json: Reverse map from leaf category to parent products.
files.products.json: Previous lossless flat export, retained for auditing/import compatibility.
